page_title: CAG 2-1 BOL | Cagliari v Bologna 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Gianluca Manganiello has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
90+4' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Antoine Makoumbou is replaced by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
90+4' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Andrea Petagna walks off the pitch to be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
90+3' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The yellow card goes to Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari).
88' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) picks up a yellow card.
86' Substitution. Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolas Viola walks off.
84' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
82' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Nahitan Nandez will be replaced by Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari).
78' Substitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) in, Sydney van Hooijdonk out.
76' The game is interrupted now, Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
75' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
72' Gianluca Manganiello sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
71' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Cagliari goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
69' 2 - 1 Own goal! Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 2:1.
68' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
66' Substitution. Michel Aebischer makes his way off the pitch and Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
66' Here is a change. Victor Kristiansen is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
64' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
59' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece.
58' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
57' Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
56' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a switch. Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi is coming on in place of Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The game is interrupted. Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
45+2' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sees a yellow card from Gianluca Manganiello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The foul by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
40' None of the Bologna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
36' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
33' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Gianluca Manganiello signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Cagliari players celebrate.
32' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello has indicated he is going to review the Cagliari goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
31' 1 - 1 Alberto Dossena passes to Andrea Petagna (Cagliari), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
31' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is flagged for offside.
30' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' Referee Gianluca Manganiello signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Bologna players have a reason to celebrate!
25' The goal for Bologna is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
24' 0 - 1 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is released by Stefan Posch, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
22' One of the players from Bologna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
18' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
15' A mistake by a defender gifts Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the left post.
13' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.

9' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Simone Scuffet sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
7' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
4' The ball rebounds out to Remo Freuler (Bologna) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
3' Booking. Stefan Posch (Bologna) receives a caution from the referee.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello was nominated as the referee for this game.
